Audio Runtime v{version}
https://github.com/sonochiwa/sa-audio-runtime

GTA San Andreas 1.0 US plugin. Requires an ASI loader.

Installation
  Extract the archive into the game directory. It places
  AudioRuntime.ModLoader.dll under modloader\.data\plugins for ModLoader.
  Then start the game.

Type AUDIORUNTIME in game to switch the runtime on or off.

Created by sonochiwa. MIT license.
